clue: In Pixar's 2025 film Elio, an 11-year-old boy is beamed up and mistaken for Earth's leader by this interplanetary organization.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Communiverse! Elio has been sending messages into space hoping for exactly this. [laughs] Careful what you wish for, kid.

clue: In the 2006 Disney Channel movie High School Musical, Troy and Gabriella's East High teams go by this name.
reveal: The correct answer is the Wildcats! [laughs] What team? WILDCATS! We're all in this together, and we're all still singing it.

clue: In 2015's Descendants, Mal, a teen from the Isle of the Lost, is the daughter of this Sleeping Beauty villain.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Maleficent! Mal's friends are the kids of the Evil Queen, Jafar and Cruella. [chuckles] Rotten to the core!

clue: In 1992's The Mighty Ducks, Coach Gordon Bombay's District 5 peewee team pulls off this famous formation play.
reveal: The correct answer is the Flying V! [laughs] Quack, quack, quack! The movie was such a hit that Disney named a real NHL team the Mighty Ducks of Anaheim.

clue: In 2003's Holes, Stanley digs at Camp Green Lake, and his last name reads the same backwards as his first. Name him: Stanley who?
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Yelnats! Stanley Yelnats, the fourth. [chuckles] Blame his no-good-dirty-rotten-pig-stealing great-great-grandfather.

clue: In 1997's Flubber, Robin Williams invents bouncing green goo. Its name is short for these two words.
reveal: The correct answer is flying rubber! [laughs] It's a remake of The Absent-Minded Professor from 1961. That goo has a lot of personality.

clue: In the 2021 film Jungle Cruise, Lily Houghton hires skipper Frank Wolff to find a magic tree called this.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Tears of the Moon! Its petals can heal anything and lift curses. [chuckles] And yes, Frank's puns came straight from the ride.

clue: At the superhero school in 2005's Sky High, students who are labeled sidekicks go into this track instead of the Hero track.
reveal: The correct answer is Hero Support! [laughs] Coach Boomer decides it in Power Placement, and his word is law. No whiner babies!
